title: AND, OR, Sort!
statement: Given a binary string of length n up to 2·10^5, an operation replaces s_i with the AND or OR of prefix s_1..s_i. The task asks for the minimum number of operations to sort the string. Since s_1 never changes, s_1=1 forces all ones. Otherwise it reduces to minimum flips to a monotone 0...01...1 string, found by scanning split points with prefix counts.
